free_tier.stated: The page states plainly that "The Grid'5000 Open-Access program is closed" and directs readers to the account page instead. Grid'5000 is an instrument of roughly 1,000 nodes across French sites plus the universities of Luxembourg and Louvain, used by reserving specific nodes interactively rather than by queueing jobs, and an account now requires justifying a use of the testbed "for its intended purposes" at a French site.

interface_detail: inferred from the tooling the provider documents; not probed
chaining: Nothing composes, and the reason is the point: Grid'5000 was the standard recommendation for a researcher outside France who needed bare-metal experimentation, and the closure removes that path, so any chain built on it has to start again from CloudLab or FABRIC.

limits.value: The open-access route for academics outside France has been withdrawn, so an unaffiliated person has neither the French-site justification nor the sponsoring lab that the account form now expects.
